Open Letter from OUR CEO and Co-founder

Is it too much to ask for health benefits that actually work?

At Collective Health, we believe health benefits should be transparent, easy to navigate, and human-centered. We were founded to empower employers and health organizations to lead the way towards a future of greater transparency, accessibility, and affordability.

Our unique, independent approach brings together the best of the health benefits ecosystem onto one intuitive platform. We connect health plans with great networks, over 140 innovative partners across 30+ clinical categories, while keeping it simple for everyday people. Our novel approach delivers the flexibility of a "carved-out" model with the simplicity of a "carved-in" experience. And our results speak for themselves.

You have my commitment to constant innovation and collaboration, and to delivering the 21st-century health benefits experience we all deserve.

Ali Diab
